content:
[1] Apple has released the second iOS 27.2 public beta, which includes the all-new Health app on iPhone.

[2] iOS 27.2 beta includes all-new Health app and more

[3] iOS 27.2 is the next release that will follow the official launch of iOS 27 from September 14. iOS 27.1 is just for iPhone Duo.

[4] The first iOS 27.2 public beta included these changes:

  • [5] Apple 的全新 Health app 設計喺 iPhone 18 Pro 發布會上首次公布，依家已經喺呢個 beta 版本正式登場。
  • [6] Dual capture mode comes to Group FaceTime.
  • [7] Siri AI 語言支援新增法文、日文、韓文、葡萄牙文同西班牙文。
  • [8] Apple TV app profiles come to iPhone.
  • [9] Up Next 喺 Apple Podcasts 改名做「New Episodes」。「Continue Playing」分區依家直接置於「New Episodes」下方。Podcast 嘅節目列表背景仲會用同 icon 襯色嘅配色。
  • [10] Apple Music app 入面嘅 label 用嘅 icon 顏色比例減少咗。

[11] iOS 27.2 預計會喺今個月稍後時間正式推出。想提早試用全新 Apple Health app 嘅 iPhone 用戶，依家可以透過開發者 beta 或者公開 beta 渠道試玩。

[12] Do more with your Apple products
